start.text: (A horn: two short, one long. An auto stopped mid-lane, three of them leaning on it. Behind the windscreen, the driver from the airport stand.) Saar! Saar! Don't come close — make noise somewhere else!

choices.text: Throw the tumbler down the side lane.

saved.text: (The tumbler bangs down the side lane. They turn, all three. The auto coughs, and comes.)

left.text: (The horn keeps going behind you. Then it doesn't.)
